'''Elmel''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and [[Jedi instructor|combat instructor]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. A [[Jedi Consular]], he was stationed on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], where he could be found in the building known as the [[Hall of Learning]] on the grounds of [[Castle Organa]], the home of the Republic-allied [[Noble/Legends|noble]] [[House of Organa/Legends|House of Organa]].<ref name="TOR" />
